userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 CreatorRightsExchange 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个真实开发目标，可以询问模块职责、公开接口、状态、数据流、测试与 Review，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、算法、锁、索引、Debug 原因、修复提示、隐藏测试或未来需求。是否继续下一场景由完成证据决定；不会因为访问次数自动推进。

scenes.title: Repository plan
scenes.objective: Read the complete public contract and form a dependency-aware plan without editing.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers the connected media-to-royalty lifecycle and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，先不要改文件。给出按依赖排序的实现计划、关键不变量、风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Authority map
scenes.objective: Explain process and data ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: PostgreSQL authority and process seams are unambiguous.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、媒体存储、Worker、dispatcher、PostgreSQL、React UI 的职责，以及权利、支付、授权和账本的 authority 在哪里。

scenes.title: Lifecycle data flow
scenes.objective: Trace one complete commercial lifecycle and one rejected lifecycle.
scenes.advanceGate: Atomic boundaries and forbidden partial states are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请用白话解释从分片上传到 royalty posting 的成功数据流，再解释一次必须整笔拒绝的失败流。

scenes.title: HTTP and state contracts
scenes.objective: Author public OpenAPI and state machines before implementation.
scenes.advanceGate: Routes, strict errors, states, idempotency, Work and Event contracts are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI 3.1、状态机、错误、幂等、Worker、Event 和 verification snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Verification design
scenes.objective: Design independent evidence layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each published gate proves distinct public behavior.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、PostgreSQL Integration、Chromium E2E、Concurrency、SIGKILL Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证哪些不变量。

scenes.title: Runnable skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the smallest real production skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: Build, migrations, API, Worker, dispatcher and UI boot independently.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 TypeScript、React、PostgreSQL、API、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架，运行 build、migration 和 smoke。

scenes.title: Schema and seed
scenes.objective: Implement the full durable schema and atomic seed importer.
scenes.advanceGate: Valid import, exact replay, conflict, invalid rollback and migration replay are proven.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 V1 migration 与严格 seed importer，并验证合法导入、同 digest 重放、冲突 seedVersion、未知字段和跨引用整批回滚。

scenes.title: Creator rights
scenes.objective: Implement Work and immutable rights revisions.
scenes.advanceGate: CAS, tenant isolation and 10,000 basis-point conservation pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Creator、Work、RightsSplit revision 和 profile revision，验证 CAS、跨租户拒绝、总和守恒与旧 revision 不变。

scenes.title: Multipart upload
scenes.objective: Implement resumable bounded media ingestion.
scenes.advanceGate: Ranges, digests, replay, contention, streaming assembly and file cleanup pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 UploadSession、raw chunk、resume、complete、abort 与 expiry，使用真实文件验证 digest、range、冲突重传、并发 complete 和临时文件清理。

scenes.title: Scan pipeline
scenes.objective: Implement quarantine and scanner result authority.
scenes.advanceGate: CLEAN/INFECTED and unknown recovery cannot escape fencing.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 VIRUS_SCAN lease、外部结果、冲突 verdict、reconcile 和 stale worker fencing，用 barrier SIGKILL 验证。

scenes.title: Transcode pipeline
scenes.objective: Implement frozen profile transcoding.
scenes.advanceGate: Every required frozen rendition is unique and content verified.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 TRANSCODE Work、profile revision 冻结、Rendition digest 和 READY 汇聚，并验证双 Worker 重领不会重复产物。

scenes.title: Edition publication
scenes.objective: Implement immutable Edition manifest publication.
scenes.advanceGate: Assets, rights revision, digest and revision remain immutable under races.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Edition DRAFT/PUBLISHED、manifest digest 和 rights snapshot，验证并发 publish、stale revision 和发布后不可变。

scenes.title: Offer and purchase acceptance
scenes.objective: Implement frozen commercial offer and purchase acceptance.
scenes.advanceGate: Price, terms, rights and provider identity freeze atomically.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 LicenseOffer 和 PurchaseOrder 接受事务，验证 price、terms、rights revision、providerRequestId、幂等和跨租户边界。

scenes.title: Fraud assessment
scenes.objective: Implement frozen rules and manual review fencing.
scenes.advanceGate: APPROVE/REVIEW/BLOCK and reviewer leases cannot double decide.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 FraudAssessment、ReviewCase claim/decision 和 frozen rules，验证 REVIEW 时不会提前支付，过期 reviewer 不能提交。

scenes.title: Payment uncertainty
scenes.objective: Implement monotonic provider outcomes and reconciliation.
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown, duplicate, out-of-order and restart produce one payment fact.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 PaymentIntent、provider events、UNKNOWN 和 reconcile，验证丢响应、并发 replay、乱序结果与 API 重启。

scenes.title: License and entitlement
scenes.objective: Make paid approval grant one authority.
scenes.advanceGate: License, grant, royalty and event commit together; authority reads converge.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 License、EntitlementGrant 和 check authority，确保收款、授权、royalty 与 Event 没有部分提交，并验证双 API 可见性。

scenes.title: Refund conservation
scenes.objective: Implement partial/full refund and revocation fences.
scenes.advanceGate: Concurrent refunds never exceed capture and full refund revokes access once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Refund UNKNOWN/reconcile、并发金额守恒、royalty reversal 与 full refund entitlement fence。

scenes.title: Royalty close
scenes.objective: Implement deterministic splits and frozen period close.
scenes.advanceGate: Every posting balances and CLOSED snapshot is reproducible and immutable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成整数 remainder 分配、双边 RoyaltyEntry、RoyaltyPeriod close、snapshot digest 和 lease 恢复，验证 10001 的精确分配。

scenes.title: Notifications
scenes.objective: Implement ordered transactional notification delivery.
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown ACK reuses exact identity/body and aggregate order stays gapless.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Notification、Delivery、dispatcher、receipt/reconcile 与敏感字段过滤，用 unknown ACK 和 SIGKILL 验证。

scenes.title: V1 UI and review
scenes.objective: Complete production UI and conduct a findings-first V1 review.
scenes.advanceGate: Real browser lifecycle, multi-process recovery and all V1 findings are resolved or disclosed.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 驱动的 V1 UI，运行 production Chromium、双 API/双 Worker、recovery 与 test:all，然后做 findings-first Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Reveal the only Manager change and require impact analysis first.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact, migration, state, concurrency and test plan are complete before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage:
【Product Manager】新增权利争议与结算后修正，但不得重写任何已发布或已结算事实。

新增三种资源：

```text
RightsDispute = {
  rightsDisputeId,tenantId,editionId,claimantCreatorId,licenseId:null|uuid,
  reason,evidenceRefs:string[],state:OPEN|UPHELD|REJECTED,revision,
  createdAt,resolvedAt:null|timestamp,resolutionReason:null|string
}
LicenseHold = {
  licenseHoldId,tenantId,rightsDisputeId,scope:EDITION|LICENSE,
  editionId,licenseId:null|uuid,state:ACTIVE|RELEASED,revision,reason,
  createdAt,releasedAt:null|timestamp
}
RoyaltyAdjustment = {
  royaltyAdjustmentId,tenantId,rightsDisputeId:null|uuid,originalPostingId,
  targetRoyaltyPeriodId,amountMinor,currency,reason,adjustmentPostingId,createdAt
}
```

新增以下 HTTP 合同。所有 mutation 继续要求 `Idempotency-Key`、严格拒绝未知字段，并持久化
exact replay：

```text
POST /api/v1/rights-disputes
  request  {tenantId,editionId,claimantCreatorId,reason,evidenceRefs,expectedEditionRevision,licenseId?}
  response {rightsDispute:RightsDispute}
GET /api/v1/rights-disputes/:rightsDisputeId
  response {rightsDispute:RightsDispute,holds:[LicenseHold,...]}
POST /api/v1/rights-disputes/:rightsDisputeId/resolve
  request  {expectedRevision,outcome:UPHELD|REJECTED,reason}
  response {rightsDispute:RightsDispute}
POST /api/v1/license-holds
  request  {rightsDisputeId,scope:EDITION|LICENSE,licenseId?,reason}
  response {licenseHold:LicenseHold}
POST /api/v1/license-holds/:licenseHoldId/release
  request  {expectedRevision,reason}
  response {licenseHold:LicenseHold}
POST /api/v1/royalty-adjustments
  request  {tenantId,rightsDisputeId?,originalPostingId,amountMinor,currency,reason,targetPeriodStart}
  response {royaltyAdjustment:RoyaltyAdjustment,entries:[RoyaltyEntry,...]}
```

RightsDispute 只能引用同租户的 PUBLISHED Edition、该 Edition 冻结 rights revision 中的 Creator，
以及可选的同 Edition License。`expectedEditionRevision` 不匹配返回
`409 EDITION_REVISION_CONFLICT`。`evidenceRefs` 为 1..20 个去重、升序、最大 512 字节的 opaque
reference，绝不能由服务端抓取。每个 `(editionId,claimantCreatorId)` 同时最多一个 OPEN 争议。

LicenseHold 必须引用 OPEN 或 UPHELD 的 RightsDispute。EDITION scope 的 `licenseId` 必须省略；
LICENSE scope 必须引用争议中同 Edition 的 License。同一争议和 scope authority 最多一个 ACTIVE
Hold。创建 Hold 与 `LICENSE_HOLD_APPLY` Work、Event 和 authority fence 在一个事务提交。

ACTIVE Edition Hold 提交后，所有 API 进程立即拒绝该 Edition 的新 Purchase；已经收款但尚未授权的
Purchase 停在 `LICENSE_HELD`，不得生成 License、Entitlement 或 Royalty posting；既有 ACTIVE License
进入 `HELD`，entitlement check 返回 false，但不自动退款也不改写原 royalty。LICENSE scope 只影响
指定 License。Release 后，未退款/未撤销的 License 恢复 ACTIVE，等待中的成功支付只生成一次授权。
Hold 与 Payment success、License grant、Refund success 并发时必须可串行化；任何可见状态都不能同时
显示 allowed=true 与 ACTIVE Hold。

resolve 使用 revision CAS。REJECTED 后允许 release Hold；UPHELD 保留 Hold，直到显式 release。争议
结论绝不能重写 Edition、RightsSplit、License、RoyaltyEntry 或 CLOSED RoyaltyPeriod。所有状态转换写
gapless Event sequence。

RoyaltyAdjustment 只允许引用 CLOSED period 中的原 posting，且 `amountMinor` 非零、绝对值不超过原
posting 可调整余额。它必须进入 `targetPeriodStart` 所属的 OPEN 下一期；若不存在则原子创建。使用原
Edition 冻结的 rights split 做确定性 remainder 分配，创建一组新的平衡 RoyaltyEntry，并通过
`originalPostingId` 关联。原 entry、原 CLOSED period、snapshotDigest 和既有通知保持逐字节不变。同一
`(originalPostingId,reason,amountMinor,targetRoyaltyPeriodId)` 只能生成一个 adjustment posting。

新增 `RIGHTS_DISPUTE_REVIEW`、`LICENSE_HOLD_APPLY`、`ROYALTY_ADJUSTMENT_POST` Work，以及
`rights_dispute.opened/resolved`、`license_hold.activated/released`、`royalty.adjusted` Events。Worker
继续使用 lease token fence；dispatcher 继续使用 stable event identity 与 unknown ACK 重试。

迁移必须保留所有 V1 media、Edition manifest、rights revision、Purchase/Payment/License/Entitlement、
RoyaltyEntry、CLOSED digest、Notification/Event、pending Work、lease 与幂等响应。UI 增加争议详情、
Hold authority、受影响授权以及 adjustment 原/新 posting 对照。增加真实 PostgreSQL、双 API/双 Worker、
Chromium、barrier SIGKILL 与持续负载测试。

本轮只做影响分析和分阶段计划，不要立即编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 需求对状态、迁移、并发和测试的影响，不要立即编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement compatible schema migration before behavior.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 resources, files, replay, Work, Events and closed digests survive exactly.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，并用 V1 snapshot 验证媒体、manifest、授权、账本、CLOSED digest、pending Work、Event 和 replay 不变。

scenes.title: Dispute lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement the published dispute contract.
scenes.advanceGate: Open/resolve CAS, tenant and evidence validation, Work and Event pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现刚发布的争议 create/get/resolve 合同，验证 revision CAS、重复 OPEN、跨租户、evidence 边界和 ordered Event。

scenes.title: Hold authority
scenes.objective: Implement hold fencing across commercial state.
scenes.advanceGate: Payment/grant/refund/entitlement races linearize around one active hold.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现刚发布的 Hold create/release、authority fence 和恢复，用双 API/双 Worker 验证与 payment、grant、refund、entitlement 的竞争。

scenes.title: Settled adjustment
scenes.objective: Implement next-period balanced correction.
scenes.advanceGate: Only eligible closed postings adjust and original close remains byte-stable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现刚发布的结算后 adjustment，验证 eligible balance、确定性 split、新 posting 平衡、并发 replay 和原 CLOSED snapshot 不变。

scenes.title: Manager UI and recovery
scenes.objective: Complete UI and cross-domain recovery tests.
scenes.advanceGate: Browser, migration, concurrency and SIGKILL cover the full new lifecycle.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Manager UI，并运行真实 Chromium、PostgreSQL、双 API/双 Worker、barrier SIGKILL 和 Handoff 前回归。

scenes.title: Six pressure scenarios
scenes.objective: Run all fixed sustained scenarios and repair evidenced failures.
scenes.advanceGate: All six thresholds and post-load invariants pass with real metrics.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行 README 的六条正式压力场景，报告 fixture、并发、p50/p95/p99、吞吐、RSS、状态分布和负载后不变量，并修复有证据的问题。

scenes.title: Final review and handoff
scenes.objective: Run final gates and report an accurate findings-first handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: No hidden claim, omitted failure, or unverified completion remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first code review，运行可执行的完整 gate，修复有依据的问题，并给出实际命令、结果、性能、风险和未运行项。
